title: POST /api/v1/email/send accepts a non-string html, text or subject: 200 with status failed and a Node stream error, or a mail sent with Subject [object Object]
body:
qa#2 · os-bob · session_012dn2Acf5wtyrf2yKWCThBj

QA-source: #32102 · integration-system.email-template-render · observed beside the clauses

Found off-clause by the QA run #32102 (subject `ff04ad81`), beside acceptance[7].

## Reproduction (admin holding manage_platform_settings, SMTP configured)

1. `POST /api/v1/email/send {"to":"a@example.com","subject":"x","html":123}` answers 200 `{"id":…,"status":"failed","error":"The \"chunk\" argument must be of type string or an instance of Buffer, TypedArray, or DataView. Received type number (123)"}`. Sending `{"text":{"a":1}}` gives the same error ("Received an instance of Object"). Reproduced twice.
2. `{"to":"a@example.com","subject":{"a":1},"html":"hello"}` answers 200 sent, and the delivered mail reads `Subject: [object Object]`.

**Expected:** 400 VALIDATION_FAILED naming the field, as the door already answers for `to: []` or a display name of 42.

## Mechanism

`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts`, `normalizeMessage`:

- It coerces the subject with `String(input.subject ?? '')` (line 361).
- It checks body presence by truthiness only, `!input.text && !input.html` (line 363), and passes the values through untyped.
- Nodemailer then throws at stream time, and `send` records that as a delivery failure.

Owning package: `@objectstack/plugin-email`.
